title: The Pool Available to a Traveller Where a Party Shares a Booking on Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
# Air Ticket Fare Brands: The Pool Available to a Traveller Where a Party Shares a Booking

A cancelled booking under Air Ticket Fare Brands may have priced more than one traveller, and the brand that produced the voucher may make credits transferable or non-transferable. What those two things settle is the pool available to the traveller itself, and the judgements below follow from them alone.

**What a base-fare line is.** A base-fare line is a fare charge line standing on the cancelled booking under the base-fare category. The number of base-fare lines is the count of such lines standing on that booking.

**Where the fare brand that produced the voucher makes credits non-transferable and more than one base-fare line stands on the cancelled booking.** The pool available to the traveller is the open pool divided by the number of base-fare lines standing on that booking.

**Where the fare brand that produced the voucher makes credits transferable and more than one base-fare line stands on the cancelled booking.** The pool available to the traveller is the open pool less the agency service fee of the fare brand held for each traveller beyond the first, and is never below zero.

**In any other case.** The pool available to the traveller is the whole of the open pool. This covers a cancelled booking on which no more than one base-fare line stands, whether the brand makes credits transferable or non-transferable.

**Worked on hypothetical figures.** Take an open pool of 1,200.00 and three base-fare lines standing on the cancelled booking. Where the brand makes credits non-transferable, the pool available to the traveller is 1,200.00 divided by three, that is 400.00. Where the brand makes credits transferable, and taking the agency service fee of the brand held to be 45.00 for the purposes of this illustration only, two travellers stand beyond the first, so 90.00 comes off and the pool available to the traveller is 1,110.00. Take instead the same open pool with a single base-fare line standing on the booking: the pool available to the traveller is 1,200.00.
